title: Butterfly Drop
description: P2P file sharing via WebRTC — no cloud, no account, no middleman. Files go directly device to device.

title: Orb
description: A 3D spatial browser where tabs float in space instead of a bar. Built with Go and Three.js, no Electron.

title: react-ol-choropleth
description: React component library for interactive choropleth maps using OpenLayers. Customizable color scales, tooltips, and legends.

title: Uplnk
description: Framework-agnostic file upload primitive. Progress reporting, smart retries, batch operations. Works with S3, GCP, Azure — or anything.

title: Vasuala
description: Real-time music visualizer for live performance. Audio maps to 40+ cinematic scenes via raymarching, GPU particles, and GLSL shaders.
